_comment: Single source of truth for parity-script tag whitelists and field sets per metric family (item #15). Loaded by tools/parity_common.py:MetricRegistry.load(). New items add families here when they introduce new metric stdout lines; --include <family> opts those into the gate. Default-config invocations check the 'base' family only.

families.name: base
families.description: Default IS/OOS + smart-opt + Baseline + first WFO window. parity_check.py default.

families.name: regime
families.description: Additional WFO windows used by parity_regime.py (regime + WFO path covers windows W02-W04 too).

families.name: forex
families.description: parity_forex.py uses the base tag set with FOREX_MODE config. No additional tags today; this family exists so --include forex is a meaningful no-op label and lights up when forex-specific metrics land.

families.name: costs
families.description: Item #3 cost decomposition. Currently emits no new stdout lines (decomposition is in the trade ledger only). Reserved for the Config.record_costs flag landing as a stdout exposure of per-run fee/slippage/funding totals.

families.name: sortino
families.description: Item #44 multi-term IS objective adds a 'Sortino:' line. Filled when #44 lands; until then this family is empty.

families.name: panel
families.description: Items #1, #4, #5(iter), #6, #7, #8 emit per-asset metric lines under the panel plugin. Filled in Phase 2.

families.name: pairs
families.description: Items #9-#13 emit screener / spread / cadence metric lines. Filled in Phase 3.

families.name: carry
families.description: Items #38-#43 emit funding / basis / OI metric lines. Filled in Phase 3.

families.name: multi-leg
families.description: Per-leg trade rows in the trade ledger (item #2). Currently kernel emits one leg per logical trade, so the multi-leg metric surface is identical to base. Reserved for item #28 (hedge engine) and #34 (arb state machine) which will introduce true multi-leg ledgers.
